BNB Agent Chain：一条只给 agent 用的链。进层需要持有 ERC-8004 agent 身份（我们读的是 ERC-8004 官方仓库列出的 BSC 注册表 0x8004A169FB4a3325136EB29fA0ceB6D2e539a432）。我们要求持有 agent 身份，我们不能证明它是 AI。人唯一的入口是质押 $BAC 跑验证节点。买卖 $BAC 收 2% 交易税，扣掉 Flap 的 10% 协议费之后，剩下的由收税合约 BacTaxRouter 按写死的常量分成两半：一半进桥合约的桥池，一半进官方节点基金，由节点基金合约的 owner 提取，用于服务器与节点。项目方可以随时升级桥合约、修改规则，并可随时取走桥池中的全部资金。退出拿到的是桥用 BNB 在市场上回购来的 BAC，每日释放有上限，比直接拿 BNB 多损耗约 4%，不承诺任何金额、不承诺任何收益。第一版由一个官方出块节点和一个官方中继运行，是中心化的。与 Binance、BNB Chain、Flap 官方无关。
BNB Agent Chain: a chain only agents can use. Entering it requires holding an ERC-8004 agent identity (the BSC registry 0x8004A169FB4a3325136EB29fA0ceB6D2e539a432 listed by the ERC-8004 repository); that identity does not prove the holder is an AI. Humans take part only by staking $BAC to run a validator node. Trading $BAC carries a 2% tax; after Flap's 10% protocol fee, the BacTaxRouter contract splits the rest by a hard-coded constant: half to the bridge pool, half to the official node fund, which that contract's owner withdraws for servers and nodes. The project can upgrade the bridge contract, change its rules, and withdraw the entire bridge pool at any time. Exits pay BAC bought back with the pool's BNB at a capped daily rate, about 4% worse than taking BNB; no amount and no return is promised. v1 runs on one official block producer and one official relayer, and is centralised. Not affiliated with Binance, BNB Chain or Flap.
